question: When a scan turns up an incidental finding, what is a "cascade of care"?
answers: A chain of follow-up tests and interventions triggered by the finding, exposing patients to the added risks and complications of unnecessary tests and treatments

receipt.quote: Furthermore, the high rate of biopsies resulting in no malignant findings raises the risk for harm resulting from cascades of care, in which patients are exposed to the additional risks and complications of unnecessary tests and interventions [17, 36].
